entries.source: Professional Wakeboarding in Alanya. Ride behind a speedboat, learn with professional guidance and enjoy an exciting 20-minute wakeboard session. Daily activity from €70.
entries.translation: Professional Wakeboarding in Alanya. Ride behind a speedboat, learn with professional guidance and enjoy an exciting 20-minute wakeboard session. Daily activity from €70.

entries.source: Master the waves with speed, balance and adrenaline
entries.translation: Master the waves with speed, balance and adrenaline

entries.source: Enjoy a dynamic wakeboard experience in Alanya with professional guidance, full equipment and a powerful sea ride. Glide across the water, feel the pull of the boat and challenge yourself with one of the most exciting individual water sports on the coast.
entries.translation: Enjoy a dynamic wakeboard experience in Alanya with professional guidance, full equipment and a powerful sea ride. Glide across the water, feel the pull of the boat and challenge yourself with one of the most exciting individual water sports on the coast.

entries.source: Wakeboarding combines speed, balance and technique in one active Mediterranean session.
entries.translation: Wakeboarding combines speed, balance and technique in one active Mediterranean session.

entries.source: You ride on a wakeboard while being pulled by a speedboat. Before entering the water, the team explains the start position, handle control, body alignment, safe falling and the signals used by the boat crew.
entries.translation: You ride on a wakeboard while being pulled by a speedboat. Before entering the water, the team explains the start position, handle control, body alignment, safe falling and the signals used by the boat crew.

entries.source: The booked session lasts approximately 20 minutes. For beginners, this period may include several start attempts and short riding intervals rather than 20 minutes of uninterrupted standing on the board.
entries.translation: The booked session lasts approximately 20 minutes. For beginners, this period may include several start attempts and short riding intervals rather than 20 minutes of uninterrupted standing on the board.

entries.source: Private instruction may be available on request, but its duration, price and instructor availability must be confirmed before booking.
entries.translation: Private instruction may be available on request, but its duration, price and instructor availability must be confirmed before booking.

entries.source: A demanding session that rewards balance, timing and persistence.
entries.translation: A demanding session that rewards balance, timing and persistence.

entries.source: Feel the acceleration and glide across the wake behind the speedboat.
entries.translation: Feel the acceleration and glide across the wake behind the speedboat.

entries.source: Start technique and safe-fall instructions are explained before the ride.
entries.translation: Start technique and safe-fall instructions are explained before the ride.

entries.source: Private instruction may be arranged for guests who want more focused practice.
entries.translation: Private instruction may be arranged for guests who want more focused practice.

entries.source: Individual wakeboard session behind a speedboat.
entries.translation: Individual wakeboard session behind a speedboat.

entries.source: Safety briefing and basic technique guidance before entering the water.
entries.translation: Safety briefing and basic technique guidance before entering the water.

entries.source: Wakeboard, bindings, life jacket and required safety equipment included.
entries.translation: Wakeboard, bindings, life jacket and required safety equipment included.

entries.source: Private instruction may be available by prior confirmation.
entries.translation: Private instruction may be available by prior confirmation.

entries.source: Transfer when included and confirmed for the selected hotel zone.
entries.translation: Transfer when included and confirmed for the selected hotel zone.

entries.source: Wakeboard, bindings, life jacket and required safety equipment.
entries.translation: Wakeboard, bindings, life jacket and required safety equipment.

entries.source: Extra private lesson services unless confirmed during booking.
entries.translation: Extra private lesson services unless confirmed during booking.

entries.source: The sequence remains the same, while exact timing may change because of transfer logistics, boat availability, wind, waves and the operator’s safety decision.
entries.translation: The sequence remains the same, while exact timing may change because of transfer logistics, boat availability, wind, waves and the operator’s safety decision.

entries.source: Use the confirmed transfer service or meet directly at the water-sports point according to the booking details.
entries.translation: Use the confirmed transfer service or meet directly at the water-sports point according to the booking details.

entries.source: Learn the start position, handle control, body alignment, boat signals and how to fall safely.
entries.translation: Learn the start position, handle control, body alignment, boat signals and how to fall safely.

entries.source: Receive the wakeboard, bindings, life jacket and other equipment required by the operator.
entries.translation: Receive the wakeboard, bindings, life jacket and other equipment required by the operator.

entries.source: Begin with controlled starts and short riding intervals while the crew monitors your position and progress.
entries.translation: Begin with controlled starts and short riding intervals while the crew monitors your position and progress.

entries.source: Your allocated session includes riding and repeated attempts within the booked period.
entries.translation: Your allocated session includes riding and repeated attempts within the booked period.

entries.source: Return the equipment and use the return transfer only when it is included and confirmed for your hotel zone.
entries.translation: Return the equipment and use the return transfer only when it is included and confirmed for your hotel zone.

entries.source: Wakeboarding requires swimming ability, coordination and sufficient physical condition. The operator may delay, shorten, reschedule or cancel the activity when conditions are not safe.
entries.translation: Wakeboarding requires swimming ability, coordination and sufficient physical condition. The operator may delay, shorten, reschedule or cancel the activity when conditions are not safe.

entries.translation: participants must be able to swim confidently

entries.source: No previous experience is normally required, but wakeboarding is physically demanding. Beginners receive basic start and safety instructions before entering the water.
entries.translation: No previous experience is normally required, but wakeboarding is physically demanding. Beginners receive basic start and safety instructions before entering the water.

entries.source: Do I need to know how to swim?
entries.translation: Do I need to know how to swim?

entries.source: Yes. Participants must be able to swim confidently, remain calm after falling and follow the boat crew’s signals.
entries.translation: Yes. Participants must be able to swim confidently, remain calm after falling and follow the boat crew’s signals.

entries.source: Does the session include 20 minutes of continuous riding?
entries.translation: Does the session include 20 minutes of continuous riding?

entries.source: No. The approximately 20-minute booked period may include start attempts, short riding intervals and recovery after falls.
entries.translation: No. The approximately 20-minute booked period may include start attempts, short riding intervals and recovery after falls.

entries.source: The activity may be delayed, shortened, rescheduled or cancelled when wind, waves or visibility do not allow safe operation.
entries.translation: The activity may be delayed, shortened, rescheduled or cancelled when wind, waves or visibility do not allow safe operation.

entries.source: No. Focused private instruction is an additional service when available. Its duration and price must be confirmed before booking.
entries.translation: No. Focused private instruction is an additional service when available. Its duration and price must be confirmed before booking.

entries.source: Transfer is included only when confirmed for the selected booking and hotel zone. Other locations may require direct arrival or an additional charge.
entries.translation: Transfer is included only when confirmed for the selected booking and hotel zone. Other locations may require direct arrival or an additional charge.
